rule.statement: A deed may be delivered on condition that it is not to be operative until some event happens or some condition is performed.
rule.supporting_quote: In Baiya Vs. Karunasekera 1954- 56 NLR 265 where facts were somewhat similar to the instant case, it was held that “a deed may be delivered on condition that it is not to be operative until some event happens or some condition is performed. In such a case it is until then an escrow only”.
